entities.name: Álvaro Vaz de Almada, 1st Count of Avranches
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Álvaro Vaz de Almada, 1st Count of Avranches was a Portuguese knight and nobleman, with a long and illustrious career abroad in England. He was invested by the English king, Henry VI as the 1st Count of Avranches and made a Knight of the Garter.
